# WBXML golden fixtures

Each fixture pairs a byte-for-byte encoding with the tree it decodes to. The bytes are
hand-written from [WBXML1.3] and MS-ASWBXML, **not** produced by the codec under test — a
fixture generated by the encoder only proves the encoder agrees with itself.

The same files are read by `ReLiveWP.Services.Exchange.Tests`, so a divergence between the
TypeScript and C# codecs fails a test rather than showing up as a device that will not sync.

## Format

```jsonc
{
  "name": "foldersync-initial",
  "description": "why this fixture exists",
  "decodeOnly": false,        // set when the tree cannot be re-encoded (unknown tokens, string tables)
  "wbxml": [                  // concatenated in order to form the document
    { "hex": "03 01 6A 00", "note": "header" },
    { "ascii": "From: a@b\r\n", "note": "literal text bytes" },
    { "fill": 65, "length": 200, "note": "200 repeats of one byte" }
  ],
  "tree": { "ns": "AirSync", "name": "Sync", "children": [] }
}
```

Tree children are one of:

- `{ "ns": …, "name": …, "children": [] }` — an element
- `{ "text": "…" }` — inline string content
- `{ "opaque": { "hex" | "ascii" | "fill"+"length" } }` — an opaque run, always raw bytes
